about: The smart-guess measure (#2959 item 4 of 2026-10-29): three short invented lore documents, each split into the statements a lore read would give, with a hand-written answer, world (any ordinary inhabitant would know it) or spoiler (the player characters would have to discover it). Every name and place here is invented for this fixture.
